map.刮痧方向(经络走向)指示器 使用指南: Gua Sha Direction (Meridian Course) Indicator User Guide
map.刮痧方向指示器，查询各部位刮痧走向与经络循行方向，提示顺经而刮、避免逆经，规范刮: Gua sha direction indicator: look up the scraping direction and meridian course for each body area, reminding you to scrape along the meridian and avoid going against it, to standardize the operation and prevent injury.
map.背部膀胱经自上而下顺经而刮。: Scrape the bladder meridian on the back from top to bottom, following the meridian.
map.上肢三阴经从胸走手、由近及远。: The three yin meridians of the upper limb run from chest to hand, proximal to distal.
map.颈部由风府向大椎单向刮拭。: Scrape the neck in one direction from Fengfu to Dazhui.
map.：刮拭足太阳膀胱经（背腰），应沿脊柱两侧由上向下、由内向外单向刮拭，顺经为补、逆: : Scraping the foot taiyang bladder meridian (back and lumbar area) should follow one direction, down the sides of the spine from top to bottom and from inside to outside; following the meridian tonifies and going against it reduces; scrape each area 20-30 times until sha appears, and never scrape back and forth and damage the skin.

map.顺经络循行方向为补、逆之为泻，方向错可能影响调理意图；本工具给方向参考。: Following the meridian course is tonifying and going against it is reducing; the wrong direction may affect the intended regulation; this tool gives a direction reference.
map.不是，以皮肤潮红或轻痧为度，阳虚、出血倾向者轻刮或不刮；严重请就医。: No, stop at skin flushing or light sha; for yang deficiency or bleeding tendency use light or no scraping; see a doctor for serious conditions.
